summary: A Yes vote establishes an additional one-cent sales tax in the City of Vacaville, until ended by voters, for general city services.

tax.text: A Yes vote would raise Vacaville's sales tax by 1% and generate additional city revenue for services.
tax.quote: The Vacaville City Council voted 7-0 on Tuesday to place a 1% sales tax increase on November's ballot.

tax.text: A No vote would not enact the 1% sales tax increase, leaving the current sales tax rate unchanged.
